From e66bf04797f1f95a2402414c00e64d00f63d31ec Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Jonathan Cameron <Jonathan.Cameron@huawei.com>
Date: Sun, 8 May 2022 18:56:40 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] iio: dac: mcp4922: Fix alignment for DMA safety
MIME-Version: 1.0
Content-Type: text/plain; charset=UTF-8
Content-Transfer-Encoding: 8bit

____cacheline_aligned is an insufficient guarantee for non-coherent DMA
on platforms with 128 byte cachelines above L1.  Switch to the updated
IIO_DMA_MINALIGN definition.

Fixes: 1b791fadf3a1 ("iio: dac: mcp4902/mcp4912/mcp4922 dac driver")
Signed-off-by: Jonathan Cameron <Jonathan.Cameron@huawei.com>
Acked-by: Nuno Sá <nuno.sa@analog.com>
Acked-by: Michael Welling <mwelling@ieee.org>
Link: https://lore.kernel.org/r/20220508175712.647246-61-jic23@kernel.org

diff --git a/drivers/iio/dac/mcp4922.c b/drivers/iio/dac/mcp4922.c
index cb9e60e71b91..6c0e31032c57 100644
--- a/drivers/iio/dac/mcp4922.c
+++ b/drivers/iio/dac/mcp4922.c
@@ -29,7 +29,7 @@ struct mcp4922_state {
 	unsigned int value[MCP4922_NUM_CHANNELS];
 	unsigned int vref_mv;
 	struct regulator *vref_reg;
-	u8 mosi[2] ____cacheline_aligned;
+	u8 mosi[2] __aligned(IIO_DMA_MINALIGN);
 };
 
 #define MCP4922_CHAN(chan, bits) {			\
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `drivers/iio/dac/mcp4922.c`**
   - The line defining the `mosi` array in the `mcp4922_state` structure was modified:
     - Changed from `u8 mosi[2] ____cacheline_aligned;` to `u8 mosi[2] __aligned(IIO_DMA_MINALIGN);`
   - This change updates the alignment specification for the `mosi` array to ensure it meets the requirements for non-coherent DMA on platforms with larger cachelines.

### Relationships Between Modifications

- The modification in `mcp4922.c` addresses a specific issue related to DMA safety by replacing an insufficient alignment guarantee (`____cacheline_aligned`) with a more appropriate alignment defined by `IIO_DMA_MINALIGN`. This change is crucial for ensuring that the driver operates correctly on platforms with 128-byte cachelines, thereby fixing a potential bug introduced in a previous commit (identified by the fix tag). The patch is part of an ongoing effort to enhance the reliability and performance of the driver in handling DMA operations.

iio: dac: mcp4922: Fix alignment for DMA safety

____cacheline_aligned is an insufficient guarantee for non-coherent DMA

Fixes: 1b791fadf3a1 ("iio: dac: mcp4902/mcp4912/mcp4922 dac driver")
Signed-off-by: Jonathan Cameron <Jonathan.Cameron@huawei.com>

The original alignment specification `____cacheline_aligned` was insufficient for ensuring safe DMA operations on platforms with 128-byte cachelines above L1, leading to potential data corruption or access issues during DMA transfers.
